title: Option for a thin version
line: Peek at Desktop and Minimize All can now be shown as a thin strip in the panel instead of a square icon.
explanation: The Peek at Desktop and Minimize All widgets always used a square, icon-sized slot in the panel, with no way to make them smaller like the thin show-desktop strip on Windows. The widget had no settings page at all apart from keyboard shortcuts. The change adds a General page with a "Display in panel: Icon / Thin strip" choice; in thin mode the widget is a strip one large spacing wide along the panel, showing a small separator line that brightens on hover, and it keeps the usual click, drag-over and active indicator behaviour.

commits.message:
applets/showdesktop: add an option to show a thin strip in panels

The Peek at Desktop and Minimize All widgets always took a square icon's
worth of space in the panel, which some people find too noisy. A new
setting turns them into a thin strip with a small line instead.

BUG: 520970

patches.diff:
From de1b4caf4bf2692146ea4c7a1a0d583262898894 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:53:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/showdesktop: add an option to show a thin strip in
 panels

The Peek at Desktop and Minimize All widgets always took a square icon's
worth of space in the panel, which some people find too noisy. A new
setting turns them into a thin strip with a small line instead.

BUG: 520970
---
 applets/showdesktop/CMakeLists.txt    |  2 ++
 applets/showdesktop/ConfigGeneral.qml | 28 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 applets/showdesktop/config.qml        | 17 ++++++++++++++++
 applets/showdesktop/main.qml          | 15 ++++++++++++--
 applets/showdesktop/main.xml          |  3 +++
 5 files changed, 63 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 applets/showdesktop/ConfigGeneral.qml
 create mode 100644 applets/showdesktop/config.qml

diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/showdesktop/CMakeLists.txt
index c373a954bb..8efd068f4c 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@ plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.showdesktop
         Controller.qml
         MinimizeAllController.qml
         PeekController.qml
+        config.qml
+        ConfigGeneral.qml
     CPP_SOURCES
         showdesktop.cpp
         ${showdesktop_SRCS}
diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/showdesktop/ConfigGeneral.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..3ea142b788
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+
+KCM.SimpleKCM {
+    property alias cfg_thin: thinRadio.checked
+
+    Kirigami.FormLayout {
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group", "Display in panel:")
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio", "Icon")
+            checked: !thinRadio.checked
+        }
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            id: thinRadio
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio", "Thin strip")
+        }
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/config.qml b/applets/showdesktop/config.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..a78fde2d5d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/config.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+
+import org.kde.plasma.configuration
+
+ConfigModel {
+    ConfigCategory {
+         name: i18nc("@title:group for configuration dialog page", "General")
+         icon: "preferences-desktop-plasma"
+         source: "ConfigGeneral.qml"
+    }
+}
diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
index fbacb55b1d..e2719a6581 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
@@ -27,8 +27,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Plasmoid.backgroundHints: PlasmaCore.Types.NoBackground
 
-    Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
-    Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
+    Layout.minimumWidth: thin && !vertical ? Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
+    Layout.minimumHeight: thin && vertical ? Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
 
     Layout.maximumWidth: Layout.minimumWidth
     Layout.maximumHeight: Layout.minimumHeight
@@ -41,6 +41,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge || Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge
 
+    readonly property bool thin: inPanel && Plasmoid.configuration.thin
+
     /**
     * @c true if the current applet is Minimize All, @c false if the
     * current applet is Show Desktop.
@@ -96,10 +98,19 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         Kirigami.Icon {
             anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: !root.thin
             active: mouseArea.containsMouse || root.activeController.active
             source: Plasmoid.icon
         }
 
+        Kirigami.Separator {
+            anchors.centerIn: parent
+            width: root.vertical ? parent.width : implicitWidth
+            height: root.vertical ? implicitHeight : parent.height
+            visible: root.thin
+            opacity: mouseArea.containsMouse || root.activeController.active ? 1 : 0.5
+        }
+
         // also activate when dragging an item over the plasmoid so a user can easily drag data to the desktop
         DropArea {
             anchors.fill: parent
diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/main.xml b/applets/showdesktop/main.xml
index 1178d2d3b3..13a92ca1b3 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/main.xml
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/main.xml
@@ -9,5 +9,8 @@
     <entry name="icon" type="String">
       <default>user-desktop-symbolic</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="thin" type="Bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 </kcfg>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: Peek at Desktop always takes a square icon slot next to the clock
After, with Thin strip chosen: only a thin line remains next to the clock
New General settings page: Display in panel: Icon / Thin strip
Hovering the thin strip shows its tooltip; clicking it peeks at the desktop and clicking again brings windows back
